# Code of conduct

OpenDMTQ follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
In short:

- Be welcoming and patient, with newcomers above all: many people here run a server for the first time.
- Disagree about code, not about people. No insults, harassment, or personal or political attacks.
- Do not post anyone's private information, and do not share the game's files here (see
  [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)).

This applies in the issues, the pull requests, the discussions and wherever someone speaks for the project.

## Reporting

Report behaviour that breaks these rules to the maintainer, [kanggu12](https://github.com/kanggu12), through
**Report a vulnerability** on the [Security tab](https://github.com/kanggu12/openDMTQ/security) (it stays private), or
in an issue when it need not be private. Every report is read, and the reporter's name is kept private. The maintainer
may remove comments, commits and other contributions that break these rules, and may block someone from the project
for a time or for good.
